_comment: Owner goals and constraints as data (REDESIGN Phase 4). The loop reads this file every cycle; a change of mind is an edit here, not a code change. mode: grow | bank | improve.
goal: maximum happiness: every happiness factor except Tax at 0 or better, every system good in REPORT.md, traffic flow 75%+, no problem icons, net at or above the floor; energy 100% clean and renewable (new capacity verified before a coal plant is removed); zero raw sewage discharge
expansionException: only the minimum for a very-high-priority need (land for a facility that fixes a critical service, jobs if unemployment cannot be fixed otherwise, a milestone that unlocks transit); justify in progress.md
netFloorNote: fixed by the owner; no ratchet. Spendable upkeep = net - netFloor. Waiting and earning is the answer to "cannot afford it yet"; services are never cut for money.
never: ground cable, pipe or ground road across water
buying a tile no road can reach
housing beside noise or in a pollution plume
priority: critical: utilities, network warnings, fires, dead or sick waiting
services by the worse of capacity, coverage and outcome
quality upgrades with little or no upkeep
spending: one-off costs only from cash above cashReserve; new upkeep only from net above the floor, by projection; below either floor only true emergencies (utility shortage, network warning, fire, water about to run out)
forbiddenNote: name parts; no placement path may build these (owner: zero raw sewage, clean power only, recycling only - no landfill, no incinerator)
sewagePolicy: export only through the outside pipe connection at (1470,7168); no raw outlet and no treatment plant may be placed
devPointsNote: owner 2026-10-11: Subway first (4 points); points are saved until it can be bought; nothing else is bought; after Subway ask the owner again

fees.note: service fees stay at the game's default unless the owner lists them here with bounds: above the default the game applies a happiness penalty (owner constraint: no negative factor except Tax). Parking fees are tuned to keep occupancy at 70-85%.

watchDistricts.note: owner's screenshot: garbage and hearse icons on every dense building
